name: haptics
notes: 016 T023 (lane V). SC-005 in-shell arm: the same scripted break as the
determinism table runs with the bridge live; the shell's StatusSeam
(T025, lane S) mirrors the post-rate-bound cue log to
Documents/e2e/haptics-log.json, and this table additionally captures
the page-side derivation for the SAME record — deriveCues imported
IN PAGE from /app/sound.js (single source, never copied) over the
captured record-1.json bytes. ios/tools/e2e-ios.mjs then compares the
log against the derivation under the frozen rate-bound model
(haptics-bridge.md par.5: COALESCE_MS 50 JS-side, minGap 40 /
globalMinGap 16 native-side): every logged cue must match a derived
cue 1:1 in class + clamped gain (order-preserving), and every derived
cue missing from the log must be rate-bound-explicable. Exact 1:1
equality WITHOUT the rate envelope is the seam gate
(web/tools/e2e-haptics.mjs --seam, lane W) — contracts/haptics-bridge
par.6 splits the two arms exactly this way.
FRAME CLOCK (016 L3 round 1): drop explicability needs the REAL frame
cadence — haptics.js posts cue c at the first PLAYBACK frame t in
[c.t - LOOKAHEAD 0.15, c.t + STALE 0.05], so a frame hitch > ~0.2 s
stale-skips cues page-side (they never reach the bridge), and cues
posted in the SAME frame arrive at the native gate ~simultaneously
(wall deltas ~0, so the 16/40 ms bounds drop all but the first of a
burst even when SHOT-time deltas look wide). The rAF sampler below
captures [rafTs, playbackClock] per PLAYBACK frame; the page exposes
no clock getter, so the sampler RECONSTRUCTS it with the game's own
advancement law clock += min(0.1, rafDelta) from the shared rAF
timestamps (main.js frame() dt clamp + game.js update(), rate 1.0,
clock = 0 at the PLAYBACK flip) — identical arithmetic, so the
reconstruction tracks game.clock to within one frame. The comparator
models both effects on measured data instead of the shot-time proxy
(run-14 evidence: 7 inexplicable drops incl. the t=0 cue strike, all
cadence-shaped).
GESTURE-FREE by design (same law as the determinism table).

phases.name: scripted-shot
setup: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { if (window.__rules?.game?.() !== 'eight_ball' || !window.__rules?.matchState?.()) { if ((await window.__rules?.setGame?.('eight_ball')) !== true) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); continue; } } __test.rerack(1); if (window.__rules?.setMatchState?.({ shooter: 1, breaker: 1 }) === true) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } throw new Error('GH-566: could not (re)establish the scripted match (game=' + (window.__rules?.game?.() ?? '?') + ', fold=' + String(!!window.__rules?.matchState?.()) + ') — a mid-scenario page reload (WebContent recycle, the #514 class) or a rules-chain failure; each attempt re-selects eight_ball, re-stages the scene and re-injects the state, so this throw means 4 s of failed recovery, not one lost race'); })()

steps.name: the shell bridge is live (obHaptics message handler installed)

steps.js: (() => { window.__e2e.fc = []; let clk = null; let lastTs = null; let n = 0; const loop = (ts) => { if (window.__test?.state?.() === 'PLAYBACK') { const dt = lastTs === null ? 0.017 : Math.min(0.1, (ts - lastTs) / 1000); clk = (clk === null ? 0 : clk) + dt; window.__e2e.fc.push([ts, clk]); } lastTs = ts; if (++n < 4500) requestAnimationFrame(loop); }; requestAnimationFrame(loop); return true; })()

steps.name: scripted break accepted
steps.js: (() => { const err = __test.shoot({ v0: 8.5, phi: Math.PI / 2, theta: 0, a: 0, b: -0.1 }); return err == null; })()
import('/app/sound.js').then((m) => { const r = window.__share.records()[0]; return JSON.stringify(m.deriveCues(typeof r === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r) : r)); })
